subject.title: improve(doctor): keep regular runs problem-focused and compact

question: Should regular `openclaw doctor` output adopt this problems-only policy, including silence for healthy security and Claude CLI state and removal of skills/plugins inventory?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent, but deciding which healthy confirmations belong in the default diagnostic UX is an intentional CLI product-policy choice, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit handling.

options.title: Adopt problems-only output
options.body: Merge after refreshing the behind branch and exact-head checks, keeping detailed healthy inventory in the dedicated skills, plugins, security, and models commands.

options.title: Keep selected confirmations
options.body: Request a narrower revision that preserves specifically chosen healthy security or runtime confirmations while retaining aggregation and compact formatting.

recommendation.title: Adopt problems-only output
recommendation.body: Merge after refreshing the behind branch and exact-head checks, keeping detailed healthy inventory in the dedicated skills, plugins, security, and models commands.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the affected doctor, auth, and Claude CLI surfaces and are best positioned to confirm the cross-cutting output policy.
